stemMd: Two bird species feed on the same insects, but one searches the canopy and the other the ground. This difference most directly reduces what?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Competition for the same local food resources

options.label: B
options.textMd: The number of trophic levels to zero

options.label: D
options.textMd: The need of either species to obtain energy

explanationMd: Although the birds use similar food, they search different portions of the habitat. This spatial resource partitioning reduces the overlap in resources actually exploited and can lower competition. It does not mean competition is absent or that food is no longer needed.

distractorRationale.c: Partitioning feeding space does not eliminate predators.
distractorRationale.e: The observation does not imply reduced genetic variation.
distractorRationale.b: The food web still contains trophic relationships.
